title: A public course page, its markup, the catalog and the Week 1 email only name a session anyone can open

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-19: "Do a super sweep 5000 of the site... Make sure everything is complete, fully evolved and validated." Found by the end to end sweep.

detail: getCourseContext and the catalog's nextRuns read a course's linked events with the service-role client and no visibility filter, so an unlisted, circle_only or private session linked to a course by a Journey editor would show its title, day and link on an indexed page, in the Course JSON-LD and in the Week 1 email, as a seat a visitor cannot open. The course's .ics and lib/events/run-series.ts already filter on public. Production had no such session on 2026-11-19 (0 non-public upcoming events linked to a Journey). DONE 2026-11-19: both reads filter on visibility public.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
